payment.title: Payment
payment.description: Charge the visitor on your payment gateway after they submit. The form counts as paid only when the gateway confirms it.
payment.enabledHint: After the answers are saved, the visitor is sent to your gateway's hosted payment page.

gateway.failed: Could not check your payment gateway. Try again in a moment.
gateway.none: No payment gateway is connected, so this form cannot take payment yet.
gateway.noLink: {name} cannot make a hosted payment link, so it cannot be used on a form. Connect Razorpay or Stripe.

amountTypeHints.fixed: Every visitor pays the same price.
amountTypeHints.from_field: Each option of a dropdown or radio field has its own price.
amountTypeHints.pay_what_you_want: For donations and tips. You set the smallest and largest amount.

payment.currencyHint: Three letters, such as INR or USD. Your gateway must accept it.
payment.amountHint: In {currency}, written as you would say it, for example 499.00.
payment.noChoiceFields: Add a dropdown or radio field to the form first.
payment.noNumberFields: Add a number or currency field to the form first.
payment.maxHint: Leave empty for no upper limit.
payment.descriptionHint: A short note for the payer, such as what they are paying for.

issues.fieldRequired: Choose the field the amount comes from.
issues.fieldNotRequired: Make this field required, so every visitor gives an amount.
issues.minAboveMax: The smallest amount cannot be above the largest.
